formula: Phi -> (q,z) with q=q_obs(Phi), z in ker(Dq_obs), and z=0 the local zero-section
meaning: defines the branch on which fibre force and mixed Hessian are evaluated
F_z is the coefficient called F_1 in 3716

formula: F_z(q)=0 for every q in the local observed branch U
meaning: stronger than F_z(q0)=0; it is the condition needed to kill the mixed derivative
turns B_QK into the q-derivative of the fibre-force row

formula: F_z(q)=0 on U => B_QK(q)=partial_q F_z(q)=0 on U
meaning: this is the clean proof route: parent-sign a family extremum, not a point extremum

formula: F_z(q0)=0 alone does not imply B_QK(q0)=0
meaning: prevents a fake proof by tuning only the tested local point
